title.narrative: Support the Rwanda COVID-19 Health Resilience project

description.narrative: The Project aims to contribute to the country's preparedness and response efforts in the fight against COVID-19 and address the gaps in the country's available laboratory infrastructure, equipment, medical supplies and pharmaceutical needs in the face of the pandemic, by bringing both financing support (unavailable in the country) and expertise to the Project Promoter. The newly built and reorganised National Laboratory System is expected to bring significant benefits to the population of Rwanda in the face of the current COVID-19 and future pandemics, including reduced infection rate, reduced number of severe cases and reduced mortality rate.
